params.name: name
params.description: First name to predict age for. For a single name lookup, provide the name as a string. For batch lookups, use array syntax: name[]=anna&name[]=john (up to 10 names per request).

params.name: country_id
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to scope the age prediction to a specific country. Providing a country code significantly improves prediction accuracy.

params.name: apikey
params.description: Your Agify API key. Shared with Genderize.io and Nationalize.io accounts.

items.docs: Predicts the age of a person from their first name. Accepts a single name or up to 10 names in a batch. Optionally scopes the prediction to a specific country using an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. An API key is required for all requests.
